description: Experiment E10's first pass (docs/experiments/e10-generated-props.md): twenty Desert Survival props (docs/plan/13-reference-consumer-games.md, Consumer A), general-audience, no people and no creatures beyond bones. Each subject is the noun phrase the image template wraps (tools/generate.ps1, template image-to-3d/1); category and size_m are what a later scale validator (07 §7.4) will check a mesh against, recorded now so the list does not have to be written twice.

subjects.subject: a weathered rounded sandstone boulder with soft layered erosion lines, warm ochre and tan
